nodes.name: Known Issues Documentation
nodes.description: Documentation of known issues, bugs, and workarounds in the MusicVerse AI platform with status tracking and resolution dates

nodes.name: Telegram Mini App Black Screen Issue
nodes.description: Critical issue where app doesn't load with black/white screen, caused by circular dependencies in Tone.js and useSyncExternalStore, fixed in Sprint 022

nodes.name: Waveform Height Inconsistency Issue
nodes.description: Waveform section changes height after data loading due to hardcoded height mismatch, fixed in Sprint 023

nodes.name: Waveform Black Color Issue
nodes.description: Waveform displays in black without played/unplayed distinction due to Canvas API not interpreting CSS variables, fixed in Sprint 023

nodes.name: Bundle Size Optimization
nodes.description: Ongoing effort to reduce vendor-other bundle from 184KB to under 150KB through lazy loading and tree-shaking
